Home/Privacy policy

Legal

Privacy policy

How KreatBio handles the information you share with us.

Last updated <<<DATE>>>.

The short version

We collect only what you send us through our contact and quote forms or by email. We do not run a newsletter, we do not sell your data, and our own site sets no advertising or analytics cookies. You can ask to see, correct, or delete your details at any time.

1. Who we are

This website is operated by KreatBio Sdn. Bhd. (Reg. No. 202501046385), a company registered in Malaysia, with its laboratory in Shah Alam, Selangor. For the purposes of the Personal Data Protection Act 2010 (PDPA), KreatBio is the data controller responsible for your personal data. You can reach us at team@kreatbio.com.

2. Scope

This policy explains how we handle personal data across this website and in our dealings with customers, enquirers, suppliers, and job applicants. It does not cover other companies’ sites that we link to, such as LinkedIn, KodaGeno, or the Google Maps service embedded on our Contact page; those are governed by their own privacy policies.

3. Information we collect

Information you give us. When you contact us, request a quote, place an order, or apply for a job, we collect the details you choose to provide: your name, email address, organisation, role, and phone number if you give it; the sample, product, or project details relevant to your request; the content of your message; and, for job applicants, your CV and anything you include in your application email.

Information collected automatically. As with most websites, our hosting may record basic technical information such as your IP address, browser type, and the pages you view, for security and to keep the site running. Our site itself sets no advertising or analytics cookies. We use one small item of browser local storage, “kb-region”, to remember the region you pick in the header; it stays in your browser and is not shared.

Sensitive data. We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal data (for example health, religious, or political information), and we ask that you do not send it to us.

4. How we use your information

We use your personal data to respond to your enquiries and prepare quotes; to provide our products, services, and support; to process and ship orders; to keep proper business, tax, and accounting records; to protect our rights and prevent misuse of our site or products; and, for applicants, to consider you for a role. Depending on the situation, we rely on your consent, on the need to take steps or perform a contract with you, and/or on our legitimate business interests, as permitted under the PDPA.

5. Marketing

We do not run a newsletter and we do not send marketing email blasts. We will only email you in reply to your enquiry, or about a quote or order you have placed with us.

6. Cookies and similar technologies

Cookies and similar technologies are small pieces of data stored by your browser. Our own site uses only the essential “kb-region” local-storage item described above and sets no tracking cookies. When your browser loads our fonts from Google Fonts, or the map on our Contact page from Google Maps, Google may receive your IP address and set its own cookies under its policies. You can clear or block cookies and local storage through your browser settings. If we add analytics in future, we will update this policy and the table below.

ItemSet byPurposeTypeLasts
kb-regionKreatBioRemember your region choiceLocal storageUntil you clear it
Google FontsGoogleLoad the site fontsNetwork (IP)Per visit
Google MapsGoogleShow the map on ContactCookie / IPPer Google

No advertising or analytics cookies are used.

7. Sharing and disclosure

We do not sell your personal data. We share it only where necessary: with service providers who act on our instructions (for example email, hosting, couriers, and payment or accounting providers); with our professional advisers; with authorities or regulators where the law requires it; and with a successor if our business is reorganised, merged, or sold. Any provider that handles data for us is required to protect it and use it only for the agreed purpose.

8. International transfers

Some of our service providers may be located outside Malaysia. Where personal data is transferred abroad, we take reasonable steps to ensure it receives a level of protection consistent with the PDPA.

9. Data retention

We keep personal data only for as long as we need it for the purpose we collected it, and to meet legal, tax, and accounting record-keeping duties, after which we delete or anonymise it. As a default, business and tax records are kept for around seven years in line with Malaysian practice.

DataKept for
Enquiry / quote emailsWhile we help you, plus our records period, then deleted
Order & tax records~7 years (Malaysian tax / accounting)
Job-applicant emailsThe hiring period and a short time after, unless you ask us to delete them
Region choice (kb-region)In your browser only, until you clear it

10. Security

We use appropriate organisational and technical measures to protect personal data against loss, misuse, and unauthorised access. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security; if a breach affects your data and your rights, we will act promptly and notify you and any regulator where required.

11. Your rights under the PDPA

Under the PDPA you may ask to access the personal data we hold about you, to correct it if it is wrong, to withdraw a consent you have given, and to limit how we use it, and you may make a complaint. To exercise any of these, email us at team@kreatbio.com; we may need to verify your identity, and we aim to respond within 21 days. Visitors in the EU or UK may have additional rights, such as erasure, portability, and objection, which we honour where they apply.

12. Children

Our website, products, and services are intended for research and professional use and are not directed to children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

13. Third-party links

Our site links to external sites and services, including KodaGeno, LinkedIn, and the embedded Google Maps on our Contact page. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those third parties; please review their own policies.

14. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The “last updated” date at the top shows the current version, and we will highlight material changes.

15. How to contact us or complain

For any privacy question or request, email team@kreatbio.com. You also have the right to complain to the Personal Data Protection Commissioner in Malaysia.

16. How our forms work

Our contact, quote, and application forms open your own email app and send a message to us (they use a “mailto” link). This means your message travels through your own email provider; we receive it as an ordinary email and do not keep a separate web-server database of form submissions.

17. Automated decisions

We do not use your personal data for automated decision-making or profiling. We honour “Do Not Track” and similar privacy signals where practical.

18. Language

This policy is written in English. If it is translated, the English version prevails.

Terms of Sale

The basis on which we supply KodaPure products and KreatBio services.

The short version

These terms govern our quotes, orders, and supply of KodaPure products and KreatBio services. Everything we supply is for research use only. Prices shown on this site are for planning; an order becomes binding only when we confirm it in writing. Malaysian law applies.

These terms apply to all Quotes, Orders, and supply of Products and Services, and they prevail over any purchase-order or other terms of the Buyer unless we agree otherwise in writing. No other terms are implied by trade, custom, or prior dealing.

Quotes are indicative and, unless stated otherwise, valid for 30 days. An Order is an offer by the Buyer to purchase. A contract is formed only when we issue a written Confirmation. We may decline or limit any Order, for example where stock, credit, export rules, or intended use require it.

How to refer to our trademarks

When you write about our products, please:

  • Use the exact spelling and capitalisation (for example “KodaPure”, not “Koda Pure” or “kodapure”).
  • Use a mark as an adjective followed by the product word on first use (for example “KodaPure™ extraction kits”).
  • Include a credit line such as “KodaPure and KodaSeq are trademarks of KreatBio Sdn. Bhd.”

Please do not:

  • Alter, abbreviate, translate, or combine our marks with your own.
  • Use our marks or logo in a way that implies partnership, endorsement, or certification without our written permission.
